direction: JA→EN (ja-JP.yml is the Crowdin source; en-US.yml is the translation)
contentType: UI strings (not dialogue). No JA-original openly licensed game script was found within the time box; see source.md
input: misskey.csv converted from YAML by yml2csv.py (Kotomark has no YAML parser); 3216 rows, 15 with empty EN

configs.B: auto-drafted glossary (kotomark draft, 100 terms, used unedited)

sampling: A: all 21 findings. B (760) and C (93): random.Random(20261009).sample(range(len(findings)), 60), sorted

misses.method: seeded random sample of 60 rows (random.Random(20261009).sample over CSV rows), manual review; plus targeted scans (placeholder/tag/whitespace diff, term drift)

targetedExtra.note: 3 more trailing-whitespace rows; サーバー server/instance drift invisible at warning level in A/B; 1 stale EN row (accuracy, out of scope)

misses.placeholderTagScan: 0 {var} or tag mismatches exist in the data, matching Kotomark's 0 findings

coverageGaps: YAML locale files (Misskey/Rails i18n style) not parsed: converted by hand
EN target term matching folds only added plural suffixes: target 'notes' never matches 'note'; verb forms (Renoted, reacted, Federating) never match 'Renote'/'reaction'/'federation'
source-side katakana findings are useful (JA source QA) but are not labelled as source-side issues in the message
